svg.title: 04 — Helper Registration Onboarding (1440px) | SevaKhata Figma Master

g.text: Create a profile with your skills, experience and rate. Households can then find you in the directory and record your work in a shared ledger.
Fields marked * are required. Errors appear as you type.
Checked for format only. SevaKhata keeps just the last 4 characters.
Full-day cook and housekeeper. North Indian and light Gujarati cooking.
I confirm these details are mine and agree that households can see my profile in the directory.

In this milestone verification is a flag in the data, not a real government check. Your ID number is only checked for format in your browser and the server. Only the last 4 characters are stored, never the full number.
Please do not enter a real Aadhaar number. A sample such as 234567890123 passes format check.
